statements.text: SELECT c.id, c.source, c.title, c.file_id, c.metadata::text, c.text, round((1 - (v.embedding::vector <=> %s::vector))::numeric, 6)::float8 AS score FROM nodestro_chunk_vectors v JOIN nodestro_chunks c ON c.id = v.chunk_id WHERE v.tenant_id = %s AND v.space = %s AND c.tenant_id = %s AND c.namespace = %s AND NOT (v.embedding && '{NaN,Infinity,-Infinity}'::real[]) AND v.embedding <> array_fill(0::real, ARRAY[cardinality(v.embedding)]) ORDER BY score DESC, c.id LIMIT %s
